verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents its own web client: it lists "Web" among supported platforms, lets you host the web client on your own domain, and says version 1.5.0 adds WebRTC paths that enable direct access from the web client. Together these cover browser-based access with nothing installed. Evidence is limited to short marketing-level statements. missing for 10: in-depth docs on what the web client can do (view versus full control, feature parity with native clients), whether hosting requires a paid server tier, and independent or hands-on confirmation that browser sessions work.
